svg.title: G03-approve-two-xl
svg.desc: Arimo outlined design reference. Native iOS controls are schematic. Maya reviews one whole revision, with one 68-point initial-avatar block per candidate in revision order. No per-candidate action. The requested five-current-plus-two-candidate scene is a layout-only stress fixture, not a valid six-person API seed. AX5 proof is scrolled to both candidate blocks; heading/context are above and explanation/actions below in the same scroll. Native navigation remains reachable.

g.aria-label: Leila and Nina must accept the exact roster. Every existing member must approve the same roster. Either can happen first.
Leila and Nina will see only drops shared after joining.
We don’t identify who declined. Nobody is asked to give a reason.
